Stunning 4-Bedroom Middle Unit in Santorini – DAMAC Lagoons

Discover this brand-new, elegant 4-bedroom middle unit located in the highly sought-after Santorini district of DAMAC Lagoons. With a generous plot size of 1,550 sq. ft. and a built-up area of 2,200 sq. ft., this contemporary home offers spacious living and thoughtful design throughout.

Key Features:
• 4 Spacious Bedrooms – ideal for families, with ample natural light and flexible layout options.
• 6 Well-Appointed Bathrooms – including en-suite facilities and modern fixtures for comfort and privacy.
• Brand New & Unfurnished – ready for your personal touch and interior design vision.
• Prime Middle Unit Location – offering enhanced privacy and accessibility within the community.
• Modern Architectural Design – clean lines, quality finishes, and a layout designed for everyday living and entertaining.

Located within DAMAC Lagoons, this home benefits from a vibrant Mediterranean-inspired community featuring lush landscapes, scenic waterways, and premium leisure amenities. It’s the perfect blend of serenity and style, offering both comfort and a prestigious address.
